arguable.why: Keep leans generous: the resume shows clinical-data reporting and no teaching or clear biological computational work, and the posting only says classes can be in-person or online, so remote-only is not clearly met.

The required certificate-program graduate in phlebotomy or MA is a certification item the equivalency clause excludes, and the candidate holds an AAS in nursing plus an LNA license, so Keep reads the equivalence note broadly.

The reason itself calls deep infrastructure-as-code fluency and multi-account estate as code required and not shown (IaC never appears on the resume), which by the rubric points to Skip; Explore is defensible only if the section is read as non-binding.
Keep works on an hourly-equivalent reading of the $40,000 floor, but a stricter reader could Skip because the post is 20 hours a week, so $29/hour tops out near $30,000 a year.
